about.text: Akkawi cheese is a white brine cheese from the Levant region, named after the Palestinian city of Acre.

sources.text: Cured two days in salted whey brine, keeps up to a year; does not melt easily; Wikipedia classes it semi-hard

facts.v: Milk heated to 35–40 °C, rennet added and curd set about an hour; whey drained through cloth; curd hand-packed into square hoops and cured two days in salted whey brine
A table cheese, used in pastries and in kunafa; the most consumed white cheese in Lebanon, per the sources
